# INSYTIQ

> INSYTIQ is an AI-powered Instagram analytics, competitor tracking, and trending content discovery platform built for content creators, marketing agencies, and online businesses that depend on Instagram for growth. It provides actionable growth recommendations — not just raw data — without requiring users to connect their Instagram account.

## Product overview

INSYTIQ helps creators, marketers, and agencies understand what is working on Instagram, what competitors are doing, and what content to create next. The platform combines performance analytics, real-time trend discovery, competitor intelligence, and an AI chat interface into a single workflow. It is web-based, accessible on desktop and mobile, and works entirely from publicly available Instagram data in compliance with Meta platform guidelines.

- Launched: 2025
- Pricing: Free plan available. Paid plans from $39/month.
- Platforms: Web, iOS, Android
- Listed on: Capterra, GetApp, G2, SoftwareAdvice

## Key features

- **Smart Chat** — conversational AI interface that answers strategy questions based on real account data. Ask "why did my engagement drop?" or "what should I post next?" and get data-driven answers instantly.
- **Trend Explorer** — real-time discovery of trending hashtags, audio tracks, and Reels formats in any niche, updated daily. Equivalent to Google Trends but built specifically for Instagram.
- **Competitor Intelligence** — track any public Instagram account's posting frequency, engagement patterns, content strategy, and best-performing posts in real time, without connecting your own account.
- **Performance Analytics** — deep insights into saves rate, reach, engagement trends, and follower growth drivers with visual charts.
- **Brand Collaboration Readiness Score** — evaluates profile quality, engagement consistency, and Reels performance to estimate partnership readiness and potential collaboration value.
- **Multi-Account Dashboard** — manage and compare multiple Instagram accounts from one centralised view, designed for agencies and social media managers.

## Who it is for

- Instagram content creators wanting to understand what drives their growth
- Social media marketers needing actionable recommendations, not just dashboards
- Digital marketing agencies managing multiple client Instagram accounts
- Influencer marketing managers tracking creator performance and brand readiness
- Small and medium businesses using Instagram as a primary growth channel

## How INSYTIQ differs from competitors

- Works without connecting an Instagram account — analyzes publicly available data only
- AI interprets data and tells users what to do next, rather than just displaying metrics
- Instagram-specific — built for depth on one platform rather than shallow coverage across many
- Trend Explorer surfaces rising content patterns before they peak, enabling early-mover advantage
- Brand Collaboration Score is unique to INSYTIQ — no other Instagram analytics platform offers this feature

## Comparison context

INSYTIQ is often compared to: Later, Hootsuite, Sprout Social, Iconosquare, and Sked Social. Unlike these tools, INSYTIQ focuses exclusively on Instagram, does not require account connection for competitor and trend data, and uses AI to generate actionable recommendations rather than presenting raw dashboards.
